laws.rule: Nagasaki City accommodation tax, with no lower threshold: until 31 March 2027, JPY 100 a person a night under JPY 10,000, JPY 200 from JPY 10,000 to 19,999, JPY 500 from JPY 20,000. From 1 April 2027: JPY 100 under JPY 6,000, JPY 300 from JPY 6,000 to 19,999, JPY 500 from JPY 20,000. JPY 100, 200, 300 and 500 are about A$0.90, A$1.80, A$2.71 and A$4.51 (RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82).
